chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Returns to Serpentwing Lake – Clan Consolidation & Fortress Plans
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns home to Serpentwing Lake, reunites with Autumn Leaf, and plans to turn Swallow Mountain into an impenetrable fortress with Mount Innerheart formations. The political landscape shifts as a new Marquis of Anchan is named.
og_title: Ji Ning Returns to Serpentwing Lake – A Homecoming of Power and Resolve
og_description: The prodigal son returns. Ji Ning steps onto Brightheart Island as an Earth Immortal, ready to forge Swallow Mountain into a formation-layered fortress that even Celestial Immortals would fear.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s Homecoming: Fortress Plans & a New Marquis
twitter_description: Ji Ning returns to Serpentwing Lake, reunites with Autumn Leaf, and announces his plan to layer Swallow Mountain with Mount Innerheart formations. Plus: Beishan Yin is the new Marquis of Anchan.

lore_anchors.definition: The central island of Serpentwing Lake, rebuilt by the Ji Clan to look exactly as it did before the Shaoyan clan's destruction. Ji Ning's home.
The fortified capital city of the Ji Clan, completely rebuilt into a martial stronghold with few mortals remaining. Named for the Ji Clan's sword heritage.
The most important hall of the rebuilt Ten Thousand Swords City, named after Ji Ning's Daoist title 'Darknorth'. Symbolizes his elevated status within the clan.
Two demonic immortals (狐妖仙人, wolf-immortal) who serve the Ji Clan as protectors. Descendants of Celestial Immortal Wujiang.
The current Patriarch of the Ji Clan after Ji Jiuhuo's passing. Manages the clan's affairs during Ji Ning's absence.
The oldest surviving elder of the Ji Clan. She unexpectedly broke through to Xiantian by reading Dao repositories, extending her life.
The overarching imperial state governing the Anchan Commandery and countless worlds. The change of its Marquis of Anchan is a major political event.
